|game_text=Plays on table. For opponent to deploy a character, starship, or vehicle for free (except by that card's own game text), opponent must first use 2 Force.
|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Goldenrod (Virtual Set D)]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image of this version. The current text is [[Goldenrod (Virtual Set D) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Goldenrod (Virtual Set D)]]): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 10, slip “•Goldenrod” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. For opponent to deploy a character, starship, or vehicle for free (except by that card's own game text), opponent must first use 2 Force.” Printed: a full slip (title bar, lore and game text, with a blank area where the picture is), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•The Professor”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 8 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/goldenrod.gif goldenrod.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>: “Plays on table. For opponent to deploy a character, starship, or vehicle for free (except by that card's own game text), opponent must first use 2 Force.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “•The Professor”. The PC first released this shield with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014. The PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018, so this is the earliest surviving PC card image; whether the 2014 release slip had the same words is not shown by it. This image was first kept as <code>ResetDS-Light/large/goldenrod.gif</code>; on 6 February 2021 the PC copied it unchanged to <code>Virtual0-Light/large/goldenrod.gif</code>, the file its card data uses. The ResetDS copy was never given the 2021 errata image; it changed straight to the 2022 image. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the slip above. This is the first PC card image of the card (the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018): the whole card is drawn, with frame, picture and icons, instead of a print-and-cut slip. A visibly different publication, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Goldenrod (Virtual Set D) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 3 September 2021<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/goldenrod.gif goldenrod.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/b4a011a b4a011a] (3 September 2021, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual0-Light/hires/goldenrod.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53d3e8d 53d3e8d] (3 September 2021, “Set 16 hires images”).</ref>: “Plays on table. For opponent to deploy a character, starship, or vehicle for free (except by that card's own game text), opponent must first use 2 Force. They Must Never Again Leave This City is suspended during opponent's first turn.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “The Professor”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' PC errata (image marked “E1”; high-resolution image committed the same day as “Set 16 hires images”): new last sentence “They Must Never Again Leave This City is suspended during opponent's first turn.” The bullet is dropped from the lower-left name, and the image is re-made at a larger size. On 5 July 2022 the PC re-saved this image as PNG data (“fixing sizes”); that copy differs only by encoding noise (no visible change) and is not a version.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Goldenrod (Virtual Set D) (Errata 3)]]): Card image published 31 July 2022<ref name="v3-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ab74419/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/goldenrod.gif goldenrod.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab74419 ab74419] (31 July 2022, “updated hires gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual0-Light/hires/goldenrod.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/594c3a0 594c3a0] (31 July 2022, “Set 0 Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on table. For opponent to deploy a character, starship, or vehicle for free (except by that card's own game text), opponent must first use 2 Force. They Must Never Again Leave This City is suspended during opponent's first turn.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “The Professor”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting); same words. The errata mark stays “E1”.
|notes='''Blanked:''' The Players Committee cut this shield from Virtual Set D with [[Virtual Set 23]] on 22 July 2024: the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit lists “•Goldenrod” under “Light Side – Cut”<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref>. Its text moved to the new [[Yavin Sentry & •Goldenrod]] combo card. A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
